items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Yeah, I knew him too. I knew all those guys pretty well... And then Frober worked at the honors club later on.

ctx.x: Yeah, I knew him too. I knew all those guys pretty well. I used to go around the honors club and they worked there. There used to be a line outside, a half a block long trying to get in the honors club. And then Frober worked at the honors club later on. And when they got out of there they used to piano alone for a while. And they had the ink spots too in there for a while and Frober played piano and the ink spots played in between or something like that. He worked there for a good time. He'd go around there and…
around there. What did people think of Frober?
